summary: Two roles passed the report’s evidence gates: Pigment Senior GenAI Engineer and DualEntry Senior AI Engineer. These are historical selections, not fresh listings today.
coverage: Employer Ashby and Lever sources searched; the two selected listings and application forms opened. This is a bounded search. Archive exports contain selected evidence highlights, not every screened opening.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France.
Employer-published annual gross cash-base floor > €100,000, or ≥ €80,000 with explicit equity.
No unchanged previously reported picks; historical checks are not a current-open guarantee.
uncertainty: Historical snapshot: evidence was checked on this report date, not reverified at website publication.
A reachable application does not establish hiring responsiveness or individual eligibility.
Previous selections are retained as history, not recycled as new picks.
decision: No approval needed. Check the original listing and confirm compensation and contract terms before applying independently.

jobs.title: Senior GenAI Engineer
reasons: €80,000–€140,000 annual salary and stock options meet the €80k-plus-equity rule.
Multi-agent feature engineering is central; a separate product source was read.
jobs.product: Planning and performance software for finance, HR, sales and supply-chain teams. This role improves deployed multi-agent features over a deterministic, auditable computation engine. A narrower assigned project is unknown.
jobs.financials: Employer-reported 600+ staff and nearly $400m raised. March 2026 company reporting said ARR was approaching $100m; September coverage reported a later company claim that ARR exceeded $100m. These are not audited financial statements. Profitability and runway are not publicly verified.
